properties.state: {"concern":"core","designation":"internal","kind":"functional","lineage":"original","name":"Adopting an existing system reports how much of it was actually recovered","priority":"medium","provenance":"authored","statement":"reflow2's adopt skill produces a graph of an existing system but has no measure of COMPLETENESS — nothing says what fraction of the codebase reached the design, so \"we adopted it\" cannot be distinguished from \"we adopted the parts we happened to read.\" The original reflow gated on exactly this: workflow 01e-reverse_engineering.json step RE-06 (Validation and Gap Analysis) computed an extraction coverage percentage by validating the extracted architecture back against the code — identifying unmapped functions (code not in the architecture), undocumented interfaces, and inconsistencies between architecture and code behaviour — and its agent guidance made it a stop condition: \"Extraction coverage < 80% requires manual review before proceeding.\" Its completion criteria repeat it as a required gate. DISTINCT FROM WHAT reflow2 ALREADY HAS. coverage_report measures whether INTENT has been delivered (requirements against the golden thread, per req:completion-computed); this measures whether the AS-BUILT LAYER IS COMPLETE — a different axis and the one adopt needs, because an honest brownfield model must be able to say what it did not see. reconcile_artifacts compares recorded artifacts against disk, which is nearer, but it checks the artifacts the design already names rather than finding the code the design never mentioned. The adopt skill's own doctrine already makes the case: \"You only get what you see is not a limitation to paper over: the graph marks what was inferred, confesses what it cannot know\" — a coverage figure is that confession made quantitative. Note the granularity caveat adopt is right about: node count tracks distinct contracts and capabilities, NOT lines of code (a 110k-LOC system landed at ~78 nodes while reflow2's own ~34k LOC lands near ~100), so this measure must be expressed in terms adopt actually models — unmapped entry points, unmodelled contracts, untouched modules — never as a nodes-per-LOC ratio, which would punish a coarse-but-honest model. Found 2026-07-28 reviewing the original reflow workflows. Anthony's word: capture it.","status":"proposed"}
